parameters.description:
`africastalking-sms-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `africastalking_sms` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Africa's Talking URL from your stored secrets, injects your credential header, and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds an extra per-enrollment credential via enrollment parameters.
parameters.summary: Relay an SMS through your own Africa's Talking account by posting a native Africa's Talking payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

api_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's API credential
